verdict.rationale: Auth0 documents the OAuth 2.0 Device Authorization Flow, in which device apps pass only their Client ID and the user authorizes the session from another browser or phone, so no long-lived secret is pasted. Auth0's own MCP Server uses this flow to authenticate AI tools against a tenant, which shows it works for agent and CLI-style clients. Missing for 10: Auth0's device-flow docs frame it around smart TVs and consoles rather than giving explicit guidance for CLIs and headless agents; no independent or hands-on corroboration; no detail on token lifetime or refresh for agent sessions.
